spec2def(localui.dll localui.spec)

# localui.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/localui-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(localui_shims OBJECT localui.c)
target_link_libraries(localui_shims PRIVATE wine libwinspool libuser32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(localui_shims)
add_cargo_module(localui localui-cargo localui.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS localui_shims psdk)
